Interface EpilogueService<R extends RobotBase>

Type Parameters:
R - The specific type of RobotBase that this service supports.
All Known Subinterfaces:
EpilogueService.Bindable<R>
public interface EpilogueService<R extends RobotBase>
Service for logging telemetry via Epilogue, starting from a root robot object. Service implementations are automatically generated at compile-time: every class that extends RobotBase gets its own service class. These are queried by Epilogue.update(RobotBase) and Epilogue.bind(TimedRobot).

  • Method Details

    • supportsExactly

      boolean supportsExactly(RobotBase root)
      Checks if this service supports the given root robot object.
      Parameters:
      root - The root robot object
      Returns:
      True if this service specifically supports the given root robot object, false otherwise. This returns true if and only if the root robot is of the exact type R; subclasses of R are not supported.
